Usage: g <command>
   or: g (--to=TO | --stdout) [<message>] [flags]

g groups flags.

Flags:
  -h, --help               Show context-sensitive help.

Arguments and flags of send, the default command:
  <message>                What to send; stdin when omitted (optional).
      --print              Print what was sent.
      --notify             Notify the recipient instead.
      --to=TO              Address to send it to.
      --stdout             Write it to stdout instead.
      --account=ACCOUNT    Account to send from.
      --secret=SECRET      That account's password.

Constraints:
  At most one of --print, --notify.
  Exactly one of --to, --stdout.
  All or none of --account, --secret.

Commands:
  send (--to=TO | --stdout) [<message>]
      Send a message (default).
  connect --host=HOST --path=PATH --port=INT --mirror=MIRROR --into=INTO
      Connect to a host.
  pick (--north | --south) (--north | --east) (--east | --west)
      Pick a direction.

Exit codes:
  0    success
  1    failed
  2    invalid arguments; nothing was run

Run "g <command> --help" for a command's details.
